criteria.description: The learner's ink covers the target's continuous line(s) within the tolerance band.
criteria.name: Every line of the target is drawn
criteria.observable_indicator: fraction of goal line samples (every 4 px) with learner ink within 6.0 px

criteria.description: The learner's ink stays on the target line(s).
criteria.name: No stray lines off the pattern
criteria.observable_indicator: fraction of learner ink samples within 6.0 px of the goal line

criteria.description: Dots the target line passes through are passed through; dots it leaves free stay untouched.
criteria.name: Each pulli keeps the same relation to the line
criteria.observable_indicator: fraction of assessed dots whose on-line / off-line relation matches the target

criteria.description: Every continuous line of the target reaches at least 90% coverage.
criteria.name: Each continuous line completed
criteria.observable_indicator: fraction of goal curves with coverage >= 0.9

criteria.description: The pattern is drawn with few pen lifts beyond the number of continuous lines.
criteria.name: Drawn as continuous strokes
criteria.observable_indicator: number of strokes minus the 1 continuous line(s) (pen lifts in excess)

description: Criteria authored from goal model v1 (kolam_image). Metric bands live in practice/observers.v1.json; scores come only from the deterministic band policy.
title: Kolam (final image): reconstruct the line through the dots — rubric
